title: Desired-set resolver: intersect descriptor resources with the scored profile activations (Phase F-3)
description: Build the load-bearing glue between the scored design profile and the reconciler. New pure function (e.g. resolveDesired(descriptor, profileResult) in src/pack-resources.js or similar): return descriptor.resources filtered to those whose id is activated for this project, i.e. keep resource R iff resourceActivations(profileResult)[R.id] === true (resourceActivations from src/design-profile.js, already pure). profileResult is the output of scoreComplexity(answers). This is the desired-set the reconciler's plan(desired, lock, actual) consumes. Pure/deterministic, no I/O. Must honor the §8.1 canvas exclusion exactly (it already lives inside resourceActivations, so intersecting is sufficient — verify). Grounds: investigator Phase F memo §4(#1) + §5 FP-3; src/design-profile.js:249 resourceActivations; src/pack-reconcile.js plan() input shape.
acceptance_criteria: A COMPLETO + framework==vue + ui_outside_canvas profile yields a desired set that INCLUDES ui-ux-pro-max, shadcn-vue, playwright and EXCLUDES shadcn/ui (React-only). Table-driven test.

The §8.1 canvas exclusion holds: with ui_outside_canvas==false, the desired set drops shadcn-vue, shadcn/ui, and playwright (verified by intersecting resourceActivations, which already encodes the exclusion).
A LIGERO profile (design_heavy=no) yields a desired set of only the always-on resource(s) (frontend-design) or empty per the activation predicates — never a MEDIO/COMPLETO-only resource.

A resource id present in descriptor.resources but absent from resourceActivations keys is never silently activated (it is excluded, or the mismatch is surfaced); the resolver is pure (no I/O) — table-driven tests cover canvas + non-canvas + LIGERO + unknown-id cases.
